title: Targets response
description: Response body of GET /api/targets: the targets whose series are cached. Requesting GET /api/series with a target's ra and dec (fov=0.2, max_frames=40) returns its cached series. See docs/build-plan.md.

id.description: Stable identifier, also the directory name of the cached series.

ra.description: Cached request position, ICRS, decimal degrees.

dec.description: Cached request position, ICRS, decimal degrees.

position_note.description: Where the position comes from and its epoch, for display. The UI must show it.
